facts.fact: The e-RCEV portal is published by the Direcção Nacional dos Registos e Notariado of the Ministry of Justice, Constitutional and Religious Affairs, which holds the system's main database, with coordination across Justice, Health, Interior and the statistics institute through the GITEV working group; the page is undated, so its published (retrieval) date is used.
facts.system: e-RCEV (Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais)

facts.fact: The registrar's own portal says e-RCEV's initial focus is the registration of births and deaths, with other vital events later, and lists monitoring of birth and death registration nationally and printing of birth and death certificates among its functions; the page is undated, so its published (retrieval) date is used.
facts.system: e-RCEV (Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais)

facts.fact: The registrar's own portal describes the method, in the future tense, as births and deaths captured by mobile phone or web at the registration posts, notified to the main database at DNRN, validated by the authorised registrars (conservadores) and a certificate then issued as proof of registration; the page is undated, so its published (retrieval) date is used.
facts.system: e-RCEV (Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais)

facts.fact: The registrar's own portal states only a proposed coverage of all civil registration centres in Mozambique for e-RCEV and gives no count or share of offices using it; the page is undated, so its published (retrieval) date is used.
facts.system: e-RCEV (Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais)
